overview: The Inner Ramparts are Ka Vethan’s primary defensive walls, reinforced with void‑arcane stabilizers and Luclinite battlements.
history: Constructed during the earliest Akhevan conflicts to protect the Praesertum core.
Void‑reinforcement was added after resonance instability threatened structural integrity.
Guard towers expanded to support long‑range arcane surveillance.
Praesertum decrees formalized patrol rotations and defensive doctrine.
Modern Ramparts serve as both fortification and strategic observation network.
hooks: A patrol reports anomalous resonance signatures along the battlements.
A guard tower experiences arcane interference.
A Praesertum directive requires immediate defensive alignment.
